tools.name: get_profile
tools.title: Get career profile
tools.description: Read the signed-in user's CareerGem profile: display name, target role, field, timeline, plan and trial status. Never returns encrypted career content.

tools.name: list_assessments
tools.title: List career assessments
tools.description: List the signed-in user's career assessments with their score and date, newest first. Report contents stay encrypted and are never returned.

limit.description: How many assessments to return (1-50). Defaults to 10.

tools.name: roadmap_progress
tools.title: Roadmap progress
tools.description: Summarise 90-day roadmap progress for the signed-in user: completed vs total items per 30-day block. Item text is encrypted and never returned.

assessment_id.description: Optional assessment id from list_assessments. Defaults to the newest assessment.

tools.name: set_roadmap_item_done
tools.title: Mark roadmap item done
tools.description: Mark one of the signed-in user's 90-day roadmap items as done or not done. Use roadmap_items ids seen in the CareerGem app.

done.description: True to mark complete, false to reopen.
